requirements.shall: Any future explicit environmental-hazard category is versioned canonical state and is never inferred from rendered weather or sea geometry.
requirements.acceptance: A new matrix and PortableSave version migrates pre-start, active, and completed saves without rewriting or rejecting canonical histories before hazard mechanics are enabled.
requirements.negative: A hazard field may not be inserted into the existing version-1 matrix wire shape, and changing seaState or a wave plan cannot create TSUNAMI.

requirements.shall: Future hazard mechanics are read from explicitly versioned canonical state, not visual animation.
requirements.acceptance: Replay tests cover every turn and difficulty across old and new save versions before capability effects ship.
requirements.negative: Pausing, reducing, or losing WebGL cannot change adjudication, and migration cannot retroactively change resolved reports or outcomes.

requirements.shall: The contact adapter shape-checks caller-supplied estimate records and filters them by sensing; upstream code must establish authority before supplying any record.
requirements.acceptance: Perfect sensing plus no estimates and valid estimates plus denied sensing both yield zero markers; malformed, over-limit, inherited, and accessor inputs fail closed. The current application supplies no estimates.
requirements.negative: Seeds, prose, contact quality, or hidden matrix state cannot manufacture contacts, and adapter validation cannot be presented as provenance.

requirements.shall: Contact-adapter inputs use own data descriptors and fail closed on accessors, inherited fields, and malformed values without treating structural validation as authority.
requirements.acceptance: Accessor and prototype fixtures produce no markers and invoke no getter; invalid values are rejected and per-domain totals are capped.
requirements.negative: Renderer planning may not inspect denied nested data or imply that a valid shape proves provenance.

requirements.shall: Frame pacing is evaluated with interval distributions and hitch clusters, not average FPS alone.
requirements.acceptance: Strong p95 <= 41.7 ms; weak p95 <= 55 ms in representative executed sessions.
requirements.negative: A browser test listing is not runtime evidence.

requirements.shall: Reduced motion performs no autonomous renders after the settled frame.
requirements.acceptance: Observed autonomous frame count after settle is zero.
requirements.negative: Freezing a continuously scheduled RAF does not pass.

requirements.shall: Visual quality changes by adjacent tiers with hysteresis and a cooldown.
requirements.acceptance: Three poor windows downgrade; eight good windows upgrade; cooldown is 20 seconds.
requirements.negative: One noisy sample cannot oscillate tiers.

requirements.shall: The tactical renderer and placement worker load only after the privacy choice.
requirements.acceptance: Neither module is requested while privacy is undecided.
requirements.negative: An obscuring modal over a mounted renderer does not pass.

requirements.shall: Sea, weather, clouds, stars, moon, aurora, wakes, hazards, camera, overlays, and glass remain legible in every supported combination.
requirements.acceptance: Combination matrix has noncolor text equivalents and reference review evidence.
requirements.negative: An attractive default scene does not establish hostile-combination correctness.

requirements.shall: At Dawn, Dusk, and Night, explicitly authorized visible geometry contributes its native material color and texture to a bounded, view-conditioned three-scale exterior field while the production model retains its directly lit material.
requirements.acceptance: Renderer-owned emission-only proxies feed tight, broad, and atmospheric convolution scales; the compositor preserves opaque directly lit core pixels and zero-contribution pixels, applies scene-depth and fog attenuation, creates zero halo meshes or lights, uses 31/47-second gain-only modulation, and holds gain at one under reduced motion. Day and capability or budget fallbacks keep the direct core-only scene.
requirements.negative: The effect may not mutate production materials, reveal unauthorized or hidden geometry, include selection, wake, reaction, or contact effects, amplify poor weather, or become a point light, selection outline, or global bloom.

requirements.shall: Wake semantics match vessel, fixed-wing, rotor, submarine, and creature disturbances and their medium.
requirements.acceptance: Rough seas shorten, dim, fragment, and reduce coherence.
requirements.negative: Rough seas cannot merely brighten a wake.

requirements.shall: Every state-changing or hidden-information-relevant visual has a persistent noncolor text equivalent.
requirements.acceptance: Keyboard, forced-colors, screen-reader, reduced-motion, and no-WebGL execution evidence.
requirements.negative: Motion or hue may not be the sole carrier of TSUNAMI meaning.

requirements.shall: Representative weak and strong device combinations are executed and failures retained with corrections.
requirements.acceptance: Device, browser, thermal, memory, CPU/GPU, startup, load, and pacing evidence is archived.
requirements.negative: Emulation is not physical-device thermal evidence.

requirements.shall: Blender is introduced only for a documented mesh, animation, baking, or optimization need.
requirements.acceptance: No Blender runtime/build dependency exists without a qualified need.
